lines.text: Imagine having every luxury on earth... and still feeling completely empty.
Twenty-five hundred years ago, a young prince named Siddhartha lived behind high palace walls.
His father hid every trace of pain from him. He knew only music, silk, and endless spring.
Then one day, he stepped outside the gates. He saw an old man, a sick man, and a funeral.
For the first time, he realized wealth couldn't stop suffering. So at twenty-nine, he walked away from his crown in the dead of night.
For six years, he studied with masters and starved in the forest. Until he sat beneath a Bodhi tree, and vowed not to rise until he found the truth.
At dawn, his mind went completely still. The naive prince became the Buddha, the Awakened One.
He didn't preach blind faith. He taught the Middle Way, between luxury and self-harm. He taught that suffering comes from craving, and ends when we let go.
Above all, he taught that peace isn't found in a palace. It's built inside your own mind, through mindfulness and compassion.
You don't need to escape your life to awaken. You just need to see clearly, and begin.

scenes.brief: Kinetic type hook: EVERY LUXURY / STILL EMPTY on dark obsidian with drifting gold dust.
Naive prince behind golden palace walls: layered arches, warm amber light, floating lotus petals.
Turning point: palace gates part, three stark silhouettes (old age, sickness, death) under lantern sweep.
Great Renunciation: golden crown left on stone pedestal at midnight, cloaked figure walks into forest.
Six-year search & Bodhi tree: sun/moon arcs over meditating figure as golden Bodhi branches grow overhead.
Awakening at dawn: warm gold halo and lotus petals expand behind seated Buddha; title THE AWAKENED ONE.
Core teachings triad in upper 70%: Middle Way scale, dissolving craving, radiating mindfulness & compassion.
Closing payoff: golden lotus emblem with rising embers, kinetic serif SEE CLEARLY. BEGIN.
